items.name: Initial immutable Git baseline
items.acceptance: Exact tree scope and verification receipt are reviewed before first commit
items.kill: Secrets or unintended artifacts appear in scope

items.name: Private GitHub remote
items.acceptance: Private repository and remote are verified; push has separate approval
items.kill: Repository is public or remote target is ambiguous

items.name: Remote CI and dependency security
items.acceptance: Python, Web, lock, schema and secret checks pass remotely
items.kill: Unpinned actions, excessive token permission or skipped required checks

items.name: Google Drive evidence vault
items.acceptance: Dedicated folder, least privilege and raw/safe-summary separation
items.kill: Broad personal Drive access or PII copied into repository

items.name: Gmail rights and Affiliate inbox
items.acceptance: Dedicated labels/queries and Human approval before send
items.kill: Automatic send or credentials in mail artifacts

items.name: Google Calendar expiry and renewal
items.acceptance: Dedicated calendar with rights, Affiliate and 30/90/180-day events
items.kill: Personal calendar data enters project evidence

items.name: Notion editorial interface
items.acceptance: Only editorial view; GitHub and repository remain technical sources of truth
items.kill: Conflicting decision or evidence source of truth

items.name: Google Ads JP/ja demand export
items.acceptance: Frozen JP/ja universe and raw/safe-summary separation
items.kill: Locale/currency mismatch or overlap summed without deduplication

items.name: Search Console read-only intake
items.acceptance: Property ownership and versioned query/page/country/device/date exports
items.kill: Top-row API output treated as complete universe

items.name: GA4 read-only intake
items.acceptance: Versioned qualified-session, comparison and outbound event definitions
items.kill: PII, consent failure or cohort metric definition drift

items.name: Affiliate export adapters
items.acceptance: Three approved programs with versioned status, currency and snapshot mapping
items.kill: Pending application counted as approved or multi-currency merge

items.name: Data Analytics semantic layer
items.acceptance: Modeled and observed facts, source, expiry and metric version remain separate
items.kill: Unknown inputs filled with AI estimates

items.name: Five versioned gold sets
items.acceptance: Field, policy, brief, claim/citation and CTA/conversion acceptance cases
items.kill: Synthetic labels presented as observed performance

items.name: Prompt and model run ledger
items.acceptance: Model snapshot, prompt hash, cost, latency, evaluation and artifact ID
items.kill: Secret or raw licensed evidence stored in prompts

items.name: Page-query-partner-cohort feedback join
items.acceptance: One identity chain from impression to paid, with unknown gaps preserved
items.kill: Cross-property or cross-cohort joins without explicit mapping

items.name: Initiative proposal contract and EVI
items.acceptance: Impact, confidence, cost, time-to-signal, reversibility and kill condition
items.kill: Rights/legal/security treated as weighted soft factors

items.name: Weekly three-option policy memo
items.acceptance: Conservative, balanced and aggressive options plus Human decision receipt
items.kill: Recommendation issued without cited observed evidence

items.name: Content ontology and brief schema
items.acceptance: Comparison, pricing, alternatives, fit, migration and methodology templates
items.kill: Template has no approved evidence or reader intent

items.name: Claim-evidence map and three-draft QA
items.acceptance: Analyst, editor and skeptical-buyer drafts with zero unsupported material claims
items.kill: Citation mismatch, expired evidence or invented price/feature

items.name: High-intent noindex pilot
items.acceptance: 10-15 pages, current fields, approved or disabled CTA and refresh triggers
items.kill: Rights incomplete or page becomes indexable before public GO

items.name: X, email and chart derivatives
items.acceptance: Generated only from accepted canonical article
items.kill: Derivative becomes an independent factual source

items.name: Causal funnel taxonomy and IDs
items.acceptance: Property, content, query, campaign, CTA and cohort IDs with exclusion rules
items.kill: Metric definition changes inside a cohort

items.name: CTA health and disclosure audit
items.acceptance: Broken, expired or mismatched links disable automatically; disclosure passes
items.kill: Affiliate status unknown or CTA and disclosure hashes diverge

items.name: Settlement reconciliation
items.acceptance: Pending, confirmed, paid and refunds reconcile append-only
items.kill: Pending enters confirmed EPC or invalid clicks leave denominator

items.name: KPI dashboard and scorecard
items.acceptance: Qualified sessions, confirmed EPC, profit, human minutes and quality shown together
items.kill: Modeled values displayed as observed actuals

items.name: OpenAI Responses model router
items.acceptance: Luna bulk, Terra drafts and Sol policy/QA pass project gold sets and budget cap
items.kill: Unpinned model or production change without evaluation

items.name: ChatGPT Pro sampled critic
items.acceptance: Blind critique on 10-20 percent of high-value artifacts
items.kill: Critic becomes canonical source or receives secrets

items.name: Claude or Gemini challenger benchmark
items.acceptance: At least 5 percent quality gain or 30 percent cost/latency gain without quality loss
items.kill: No incremental value, retention uncertainty or two providers promoted together

items.name: LLM tracing and evaluation platform
items.acceptance: At least 100 meaningful runs per month and approved retention/hosting
items.kill: Sensitive evidence leaves approved boundary or operating cost exceeds benefit

items.name: saas-content-editorial skill
items.acceptance: Brief to three drafts to claim QA to approved derivatives
items.kill: Skill bypasses canonical schemas or Human publication gate

items.name: saas-growth-policy skill
items.acceptance: Evidence to three options to rank to kill criteria
items.kill: Unsupported free-form recommendation

items.name: affiliate-export-intake skill
items.acceptance: Raw remains external, safe summary and funnel reconciliation are deterministic
items.kill: Tracking IDs, credentials or PII enter repository

items.name: Durable scheduler and queue
items.acceptance: Idempotency, bounded retry, dead letter and 99 percent job target
items.kill: Unbounded retry, duplicate external action or missing receipt

items.name: Approval inbox and kill switch
items.acceptance: Exact action, expiry, revocation and STOP visible to operator
items.kill: Approval scope is broad, implicit or reused

items.name: Telemetry and dead-man alerts
items.acceptance: Freshness, failure, cost, expiry and missing receipt alerts
items.kill: Alert contains secrets or no tested escalation path

items.name: Cloud runtime, database, KMS, anchor and backup
items.acceptance: One stack passes restore, RPO, RTO, rollback and least-privilege review
items.kill: Public GO absent or overlapping platforms introduced

items.name: Sites hosting and publication
items.acceptance: Noindex staging, independent readback, rollback and exact Human publish GO
items.kill: Synthetic evidence used as public authority
